title: Actually Additions Extra
description: Actually Additions Extra: ultimate addon for Actually Additions. Introduces the Advanced Empowerer, a compact machine fully automatable from any side. Includes modular speed upgrades from 2x to 20x for a faster industrial setup!
body:
***

# Actually Additions Extra

Upgrade your industrial empire with **Actually Additions Extra**! This addon for Actually Additions (NeoForge 1.21.1) is designed to streamline your production lines and eliminate the complexity of standard empowering setups.

## ⚡ The Advanced Empowerer

The centerpiece of this mod. A compact, single-block machine that performs all your empowering recipes with unparalleled efficiency. Say goodbye to messy setups and display stands!

*   **Omni-Slot Smart Routing:** Throw your ingredients into the 5 input slots in any order. The machine dynamically recognizes the recipe, making it completely fool-proof.
*   **Autocrafting Ready:** Seamlessly integrates with **Applied Energistics 2 (AE2)**, **Refined Storage**, and any pipe mod. The machine intelligently locks external pipes from extracting uncrafted ingredients—they will only ever pull from the dedicated Output slot.
*   **Smart Power Management:** If the machine runs out of energy, it will pause the crafting process instead of resetting it. Once power is restored, it will resume exactly where it left off!
*   **Native Compatibility:** It natively hooks into the Actually Additions recipe system, meaning any custom or modpack-added Empowerer recipes are automatically supported and perfectly visible in JEI.

## 🚀 Modular Speed Upgrades

Custom-fit your machine's performance with specialized speed chips. Simply pop one into the dedicated upgrade slot to overclock your empowering process:

*   🟢 **Iron Upgrade:** 2x Speed
*   🟡 **Gold Upgrade:** 5x Speed
*   🔵 **Diamond Upgrade:** 10x Speed
*   🟣 **Netherite Upgrade:** 20x Speed

_(Note: Power consumption scales dynamically with speed. The faster you craft, the more FE/t the machine will draw from your power grid!)_

## 🛠️ New Content & Features

*   **Elite Coil:** A premium, late-game crafting component featuring the classic Actually Additions aesthetic with a high-power diamond core.
*   **Sleek Centered UI:** A beautifully designed and perfectly aligned custom GUI that respects standard Minecraft proportions.
*   **JEI Integration:** The Advanced Empowerer acts as a fully recognized workstation for all Empowerer recipes within Just Enough Items.

## ⚙️ Requirements

*   **NeoForge:** 1.21.1
*   **Actually Additions:** (Required Dependency)
